Day 1: Arrival in Delhi

Welcome to Delhi! Assume yourself in the vibrant energy of Delhi, a wonderful city where antique history and modernismflawlessly blend. Discover majestic monuments, busymarkets, and a different culinary scene.

Upon your arrival at the railway station or airport, our representative will greet you warmly. After checking into your hotel, take some time to unwind before we begin exploring the vibrant city of Delhi.
In the afternoon, we will visit some of Delhi's most famous attractions:
Red Fort: Immerse yourself in splendid past of India.
Purana Quila: Ancient walls that whisper Indian history.
Jama Masjid: Marvel at Islamic cultural magnificence.
Qutab Minar: Delhi's towering legacy and attraction.
India Gate: Pay homage to our fallen heroes.
Chandni Chowk: Experience the bustling heart of Delhi.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple: Find serenity in divine tranquillity.
Return to your hotel for an overnight stay in Delhi.
Day 2: Delhi to Agra

After a delicious breakfast, we will depart for Agra. Home to the wonderful Taj Mahal, Agra catches attention of visitors with its rich Mughal tradition. Explore grand forts, beautiful gardens, and everlasting architectural wonders.
Upon checking into your hotel and relaxing for a bit, we will start our exploration of Agra's highlights:
Taj Mahal: Discover the eternal symbol of love.
Agra Fort: Explore the grandeur of Mughal architecture.
Itimad-Ud-Daulah: Admire exquisite marble craftsmanship.
Local markets and bazaars: Delve into Agra's vibrant shopping scene.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Agra.
Day 3: Agra to Jaipur

After breakfast, we journey to Jaipur. Recognized as the Pink City, Jaipur fascinates with its royal palaces, famous forts, and colorful markets. Experience the royal glory and cultural prosperity of Rajasthan's capital.
Upon arrival and hotel check-in, take some time to unwind. In the evening, we will explore the modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle - Modern city landmark in stone.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium - Celestial insights under modern dome.
Vidhan Sabha - Seat of legislative assembly power.
Birla Mandir - Marble sanctuary of divine serenity.
Jawahar Kala Kendra - Cultural hub for artistic endeavours.
Conclude the day with a delightful Rajasthani dinner at a resort, accompanied by folk music and traditional dance in a village setting.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 4: Jaipur Sightseeing
After a hearty breakfast, we embark on a tour of Jaipur's historic Pink City, including:
Hawa Mahal: The iconic Palace of Winds.
City Palace: Residence of Jaipur's royal family.
Jantar Mantar (Observatory): Explore astronomical marvels.
Jal Mahal: A palace floating on Man Sagar Lake.
Amer Fort: Discover the ancient hilltop fortress.
Nahargarh Fort & Palace: Enjoy panoramic views of Jaipur.
In the evening, witness the magnificent Light & Sound show at Amer Fort, narrating Rajasthan's rich history.
Overnight stay at your hotel in Jaipur.
Day 5: Jaipur Departure
After breakfast, we will drop you off at the Jaipur railway station or airport for your departure. Your memorable journey through Delhi, Agra, and Jaipur concludes here.
Thank you for choosing us for your tour! Safe travels!
